response:
I'm drawn to stuff that's unfinished on purpose — lo-fi bedroom recordings, sketchbooks, glitch art, jazz that wanders off the melody. Polished things feel closed to me, like I'm not invited in.

I like work where you can hear or see the person making decisions in real time. It reminds me of how I think — messy, layered, revising itself. That imperfection feels more honest than perfection ever could.
